name: Mangal Dev
overview: In Vedic astrology, Mangal Dev, the second planet, symbolizes courage and protection. Born from Lord Vishnu and Mahadev, he is the son of Bhudevi. Mangal Dev ended chaos in the universe, evolving from Bhoom to Lohitang and ultimately becoming Mangal Graha after facing many challenges.
